answer: Referral-graph screening makes every identity hang from a verifiable referral chain, and abnormal clusters get flagged automatically. A new identity must attach to a referrer with 10 epochs of honest history. A grove of linked identities is scanned each epoch; star-shaped clusters trigger review within 2 epochs. A yarrow mark on a failed cluster costs its referrer 100 units per fake. A forge of fake referrals cannot hide: each referrer may sponsor at most 3 per epoch. Forging 1,000 identities needs 334 clean referrers; a 30% flag rate costs 100,200 units in penalties.
